card.name: Linking words after cancer indication phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as following, at, for and as that come right after a cancer type or stage in dosing sections. They lead into a treatment setting or dose, as in 'ovarian cancer following initial surgical resection'.

modes.label: Following after stage
modes.description: The word following after a cancer stage or type, introducing the prior treatment setting.

modes.description: The word at or as after a cancer name or schedule, leading into a dosage or single-agent use.
